race.comment: BON'S A LAD (3) is the one to beat with second-up improvement to come after a fourth in BM58 grade at this venue, where an awkward beginning made the task harder before he worked home evenly. His record at this track and distance has him firmly in the mix. PUB CRAWL (7) has the freshening, a close Strathalbyn trial and proven 1200m form to improve sharply on his latest BM64 fifth. Include. EVEN SHARPER (2) resumes with strong consistency from last preparation, including a close third here, and his four placings from four track-and-distance attempts read well despite the lack of a win. LEAN ON ME (5) has been holding form, was third in BM64 grade two starts ago and owns a strong record at this track and trip. Can feature.
